newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds supported on euro optimism.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds supported on euro optimism.

text.p: 0850 GMT - Portuguese bonds supported by optimism over the launch of the euro after EU leaders agreed to stick to the "stability pact." Spreads against 10-year Bunds narrowed.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 66 bps vs 69 bps

Portuguese bonds strengthened at the start and spreads against 10-year Bunds narrowed amid optimism over the euro after EU leaders at the Amsterdam summit agreed to stick to the "stability pact", dealers said.
They said they did not expect spreads to narrow much further before the release of U.S. consumer price data.
"10-year Bund spreads have narrowed to 66 bp, but before the release of U.S. inflation data spreads should not tighten by much more," said one fixed income analyst.

If Portuguese inflation, also due to be released today, turns out at 1.8 percent year-on-year or less, shorter bonds will receive a boost amid growing prospects for an official rate cut, dealers said.
